No. At that time and location, the Moon’s altitude is about **−31.3°**, meaning it is more than 31 degrees below your geometric horizon. It is therefore physically blocked by the Earth and cannot be seen, regardless of clear skies, darkness, illumination, or eyesight.

Its 11% illumination and roughly 39° separation from the Sun would matter only if it were above the horizon.
